summary: The official organiser confirms the 2026 race expo and race-pack collection at Tha Phae Gate on 18–19 December, 10:00–18:00. For a non-runner, treat it as a short, opportunistic stop while exploring the Old City rather than a destination festival: the published programme establishes runner collection, but does not specify public entertainment, exhibitors or visitor admission.
whyGo: See the build-up to an international running event beside Chiang Mai’s landmark gate.
A convenient shared stop when someone in your group needs to collect their race pack.
bestFor: Running enthusiasts already sightseeing near Tha Phae Gate.
skipIf: You would make a special journey expecting a large shopping expo or scheduled performances.
You prefer quiet sightseeing without event queues and temporary installations.
duration: Allow 20–45 minutes for a casual look; runners should leave extra time for collection queues.
cost: No separate expo visitor tariff is published. Race registration is a separate purchase; public admission conditions remain unconfirmed.
hours: Friday 18 and Saturday 19 December 2026, 10:00–18:00, as published by the organiser.
bestTime: Try shortly after opening for a convenient daytime visit; this is a planning suggestion, not a verified quieter period.
gettingThere: Head to Tha Phae Gate plaza on the eastern edge of the Old City. Walk from nearby accommodation, or arrange a taxi/songthaew drop-off nearby and finish on foot. Specific expo parking and traffic arrangements are not published.
booking: No separate expo booking process is listed. Registered runners should check their entry status through the official registration link and bring a passport or its phone photograph for identification.
accessibility: The organiser has not published an expo accessibility plan, accessible toilets or queue assistance details. Travellers needing step-free access or seating should confirm arrangements before relying on this stop.
practicalTips: Keep the official event page available and recheck the schedule before travelling.
Bring water and sun protection for an outdoor plaza visit; leave room in your day if collecting equipment.
Do not assume race-day transport or parking also operates during expo hours.
decemberNotes: These are explicitly 2026 dates, preceding the Sunday 20 December race. Late-arriving runners landing after 17:00 on 19 December are asked to email the organiser to arrange exceptional collection; do this ahead of arrival.
uncertainties: Public browsing access, admission fees, stall list and entertainment programme are not explicitly confirmed.
Queue lengths, shade, toilets and detailed accessibility arrangements remain unknown.
